> Are there infinitely many $n > 2$ such that $n - 2^k$ is prime for all $k \geq 1$ with $2^k < n$? The only known such $n$ are $4, 7, 15, 21, 45, 75, 105$ (OEIS [A039669](https://oeis.org/A039669)).
